blocks.text: As Filipinos prepare for the arrival of the latest generation of iPhone, Home Credit Philippines (HCPH), the country’s leading consumer finance company, is giving customers more ways to plan their upgrade through flexible financing options for the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. Starting October 2, customers may pre-order the latest iPhone models through Apple Authorized Resellers and partner stores nationwide using Home Credit financing options and experience eye-opening control and next-gen performance for as low as ₱137 per day, with as low as 0% interest and 0% down payment for up to 24 months, subject to applicable […]...
